arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

xls = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for name in xls.sheet_names:
    df = xls.parse(name, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} (shape {df.shape}) ---")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=20))

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} (dims {ws.dimensions}, max_row {ws.max_row}, max_col {ws.max_column}) ---")
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        vals = [c.value for c in row]
        print(vals)
